title: Debiased Inference via Posterior Corrections for High-Dimensional Regression
abstract: arXiv:2512.09257v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: There has been significant progress in Bayesian inference based on sparsity-inducing priors, such as spike-and-slab and horseshoe priors, for high-dimensional regression. The resulting posteriors, however, in general do not possess desirable frequentist properties, and the credible sets thus cannot serve as valid confidence sets even asymptotically. We introduce a novel debiasing approach that corrects the bias for the entire (possibly approximate) Bayesian posterior distribution. We establish new Bernstein-von Mises theorems that guarantee the frequentist validity of the debiased law. We demonstrate the practical performance of our proposal through Monte Carlo simulations and two empirical applications in economics.

translated_title: 通过后验校正实现高维回归的去偏推断
translated_abstract: 基于稀疏性诱导先验（如spike-and-slab先验和马蹄先验）的高维回归贝叶斯推断已取得显著进展。然而，由此产生的后验分布通常不具备理想的频率学派性质，因此其可信集即使在渐近意义下也无法作为有效的置信集。我们提出了一种新颖的去偏方法，对整个（可能是近似的）贝叶斯后验分布进行偏差校正。我们建立了新的Bernstein-von Mises定理，以保证去偏后分布的频率学派有效性。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟和经济学中的两个实证应用展示了该方法在实际中的表现。
tldr: 该论文提出一种新颖的去偏方法，通过校正整个贝叶斯后验分布的偏差并建立新的Bernstein-von Mises定理，使高维回归中基于稀疏先验的后验分布具备频率学派有效性，其可信集可作为有效置信集。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel debiasing approach that corrects the bias of the entire Bayesian posterior distribution and establishes new Bernstein-von Mises theorems, guaranteeing the frequentist validity of sparsity-inducing posteriors in high-dimensional regression so that credible sets can serve as valid confidence sets.
